questions.q: Which is NOT one of the three parts of the HDI?
questions.why: HDI uses health (life expectancy), education and income only.

questions.q: Why is GNI per capita a limited measure of development?
options: It is an average that hides inequality
questions.why: It is an average and ignores health, education and how wealth is shared.

questions.q: A TNC is best described as a company that…
options: operates in more than one country
questions.why: Transnational corporations have operations (e.g. factories) in several countries.

questions.q: Explain one reason why a country dependent on exporting primary products may stay poor.
questions.model: Primary products such as coffee or copper have low, unstable prices, so export income is small and unreliable. Manufactured goods earn more, so the country does not get the extra value.
points: prices of primary goods are low/unstable
link to low or unreliable income / less value than manufactured goods
